requirement: Build a Typer CLI with global --verbose and --profile options, the profile also read from an environment variable, shared with a nested config command group without re-declaring them.
skeleton: A frozen State dataclass, a root callback storing it on ctx.obj, a config sub-app added with add_typer, and show and set commands reading ctx.obj, with set validating its key.
caption: A Typer CLI whose root callback resolves global options once and shares them with a nested config group through ctx.obj. The frozen State dataclass holds verbose and profile. The callback main takes --verbose/-v and --profile, which reads the APP_PROFILE environment variable and defaults to default, and stores a State on ctx.obj. config_app is mounted as config with add_typer. config show reads the State from ctx.obj, echoes a debug line to stderr when verbose, and prints profile followed by the name. config set KEY VALUE raises typer.BadParameter for keys outside ALLOWED_KEYS, region and output, so the usage error exits with code 2, and otherwise prints profile.key = value. The fixture asserts, with CliRunner, the default profile with empty stderr, that --profile reaches the nested set command, that APP_PROFILE selects the profile, that verbose logs only to stderr, and that an unknown key exits 2 with the message on stderr.

plan.intent: Expose shared global flags across a CLI's subcommands
constraints: Global options are resolved in the root callback and stored on ctx.obj
The profile falls back to APP_PROFILE and then default
Verbose diagnostics go to stderr, never stdout
Unknown keys raise typer.BadParameter so the command exits with code 2

rationale.teaches: Resolve global options in an app.callback, pass them via ctx.obj to nested sub-apps, keep diagnostics on stderr, and signal bad input with BadParameter.
rationale.why: Re-declaring globals on every command drifts, debug output on stdout breaks piping, and unchecked keys silently write garbage configuration.

ops.docstring: Share global Typer options with a subcommand group through ctx.obj.

candidates.why_wrong: The APP_PROFILE environment variable is ignored when choosing the profile.
Verbose debug lines are printed to stdout and pollute the command output.
Debug lines appear only when verbose is off, the opposite of the flag.
Unknown configuration keys are accepted and echoed as if they were set.
Without an explicit profile the CLI uses dev instead of default.
